title: BillsManifestSnapshotPointerV1
description: Where to download the full bills manifest. GET /bills-manifest returns this instead of the manifest when the client sends delivery=snapshot without updatedAfter and a snapshot exists.

snapshotUrl.description: Short-lived presigned S3 URL. A GET without an Authorization header returns the full BillsManifest as JSON with Content-Encoding gzip. It stops working at expiresAt.

generatedAt.description: The generatedAt of the BillsManifest in the snapshot.

count.description: The count of the BillsManifest in the snapshot (its number of bills).

expiresAt.description: When snapshotUrl expires. After it, request the pointer again.
